messages:
Maya: Quick sync — ACME pilot scheduled Wed. Need decision on MVP shipline by Friday EOD. Can’t take everything. Proposing must-have = SSO (OAuth) + non-persistent embeddings cache + telemetry. Move tenant routing, per-tenant quotas, KMS to v1. Thoughts? @Alex @Sam @Priya

Alex: +1 to gating SSO + embeddings. Emb cache gives biggest latency/cost wins. If we drop tenant routing we're still within SLA but need to confirm cache hit ratios.

Sam: We can do a non-persistent in-memory prefix cache. Infra changes: ~2w for full prefix cache; quick path (top flows) ~5d. Bench: ~30% tail p99 token improvement.

Priya: If tenant routing is out, we'll default to org-scoped UX and hide tenant selector. Placeholder copy ok; low risk. I can ship the placeholder in 1 sprint.

Tom: Customer note: ACME considers SSO non-negotiable. They accept OAuth first; SAML later. They asked about data isolation — need clear statement that data won't be used for training + logs retention policy.

Maya: Updated proposal: MVP must-have = OAuth SSO, embeddings as experimental (non-persistent), basic telemetry. v1: tenant routing, per-tenant quotas, KMS + SAML. Can eng do OAuth-only quickpath?

Alex: Yes — reuse existing auth library, estimate 3d to get OAuth flow + e2e tests. KMS/SAML after pilot.

Sam: I'll open PR with `cache.type=memory` default for MVP and perf numbers. Also add a feature flag `emb_cache_mvp`.

Emily (SRE): Need a canary plan. Recommend: staging -> 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% with feature flag. Add alerting: spike in 5xx or latency p95 > 2s.

Maya: I'll draft rollout plan. Suggest flag `mvp_shipline_acme` and short rollback criteria. @Chris can you own rollback/runbook?

Chris: Yep. I'll own runbook. Draft snippet:
```
if errors_5xx > 3% for 5m -> rollback to previous model + disable mvp_shipline_acme
if p95_latency > 2s for 10m -> pause rollout and investigate
```

Maya: Solid. Can everyone ack by Thu EOD? If not, we push pilot to next week. :thumbsup:

Alex: Ack

Sam: Ack

Priya: Ack

Tom: Ack

Emily: Ack

Chris: Ack — will add runbook to release PR

Maya: Thanks — I'll summarize and open PR/launch checklist.

deploy-bot: canary created for `mvp_shipline_acme` on staging (id: cb-4821)
